name: inductor-shielded-window
title: Power inductor, shielded, winding windows
summary: As inductor-shielded, with the sleeve open over the middle of its ±y sides so the enamelled winding shows (the WE-PD class).
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); saved at the SRR6028's outline (Bourns' public SRR6028 datasheet; https://www.bourns.com/docs/Product-Datasheets/SRR6028.pdf, downloaded 18 November 2026); the windows estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
